detail.longDescription: New attack lets hackers plant hidden instructions in AI memory with a single prompt InjecMEM is a new attack exploiting AI agent memory systems. A single prompt plants hidden instructions that resurface in future interactions, achieving 76.6% success rates. The attack works without direct memory access, exposing gaps in current defenses that focus on input/output filtering. Enterprises must rethink AI memory security as a critical boundary. https://www. csoonline.com/article/4213632/ new-attack-lets-hackers-plant-hidden-instructions-in-ai-memory-with-a-single-prompt.html # AI # MachineLearning # Security
